Opposite Parties  Mr. G.N. Rout, ASC  CORAM:
 Mr. JUSTICE D. DASH  Mr. JUSTICE V. NARASINGH  ORDER 15.07.2024 Order No.
02. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement (virtual/physical) mode.

2. The Petitioner by filing this writ petition has invoked the jurisdiction of this Court under Article 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India seeking a direction to the Opposite Party Nos.2 to 4 for payment of compensation towards acquisition of his land measuring Ac.0.04.2 dec. out of Ac.0.21 dec. under plot No.3295 Kissam Sarada-2 under Stitiban Khata No.750 of Muza Oleichandanpur,
P.S.-Binjharpur, Dist-Jajpur.

3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that although the possession of land in question has been taken over for construction of the road, no compensation has been paid to the Petitioner and it is not also known to the Petitioner as to whether any proceeding under the Land Acquisition Act having been initiated someone else has been paid with the compensation for the said land.
4.
He at this stage however submits that the Petitioner has filed the representation dated 22.04.2024 under the Annexure-6 with the Collector, Jajpur, Opposite Party No.2 and that is still pending.

He at this stage prays for disposal of this writ petition with a direction to Opposite Party No.2 to consider the representation of the Petitioner in its proper perspective and dispose of the same in accordance with law.
5. Learned counsel for the State submits to have received no such instruction in the matter as yet.

sentences.text: Considering the submissions made and on going through the averments taken in the writ petition as well as the documents annexed thereto, we dispose of this writ Petition directing the Petitioner to file a fresh representation before the Opposite Party No.2 placing all said facts in relation to the land, possession of which has been taken away in stating the grievances within two weeks hence.

7. In that event we direct the Opposite Party No.2 to consider the said representation in its proper perspective after making necessary enquiry and verification of all the records; if necessary causing the field enquiry through the responsible officer under him, dispose of the same after giving an opportunity of hearing to the Petitioner within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of the application and intimate the result of the same to the Petitioner within a week thereafter.
Issue urgent certified copy of this order as per rules.
